annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Central Bank of 13 March 2026 on a proposal for a regulation as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (CON/2026/10)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Central Bank of 13 March 2026 on a proposal for a regulation as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (CON/2026/10)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, Series C
annotation.summary_en: European Central Bank own-initiative opinion on the Commission's Digital Omnibus on AI proposal. It supports simplification and calls for an explicit legal basis for information exchange between prudential supervisors and market surveillance authorities. It also asks that generalised linear models used for credit scoring be excluded from high-risk AI systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: Welcomes simplification of AI Act implementation to promote innovation and competitiveness.
Calls for an explicit legal basis for the ECB to share prudential information with national market surveillance authorities.
Recommends extending the duty to report to the ECB to market surveillance authorities outside the SSM.
Recommends expressly excluding generalised linear models (e.g. logistic regression) from high-risk credit scoring under Annex III.
Warns of possibly conflicting supervision of CRR internal models and AI Act credit scoring models.
